scenes.caption: Silver mist parted like curtains, and Clara saw Glassvale Academy for the first time.
scenes.alt: Clara steps completely dry out from behind a shimmering mountain waterfall into golden morning mist, looking up in wonder at Glassvale Academy's central Bell-Tower, copper wind-sail spire, glass oak dome, and floating-crown Starlight Tower.

scenes.caption: Only show-offs buy the most expensive teapot, Monica said as Sam's cup began to wobble.
scenes.alt: In the sunlit oak Great Hall, Headmistress Monica pours steaming tea from a silver teapot while curly ginger-haired Sam reaches after a wobbling floating teacup and Maya laughs with tiny turquoise frog Pebble on her wrist.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: The Week of Three Sparks

scenes.caption: Fear makes starlight scatter, Peter told her gently. Breathe out, and hold the shape.
scenes.alt: Inside the starry midnight-blue observatory, warm smiling teacher Peter gently steadies Clara's wrist as bright violet-gold sparks curl above her palm, while Sam peeks over books and blond Victor watches smugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Whisper Beneath the Stairs

scenes.caption: Behind the iron bars, a masked figure in a gray coat stood watching in green-violet mist.
scenes.alt: Outside the locked wrought-iron Deep Gate at night, Clara, Sam, and Maya watch Whisper-Moths snuff the stair candles while Pebble's throat flashes gold and masked Silas looms behind the bars in eerie green-violet mist.

scenes.caption: For twenty steady minutes, Clara did not use a single spark of magic.
scenes.alt: In the golden Brass Spire boiler room, Clara holds a warm lantern and passes a brass shim while Jorge grins beside her, wrenching a frosted black clamp off a steaming copper pipe as Sam records measurements.

scenes.caption: She did not push the tree. She held gentle warmth steady until the roots softened.
scenes.alt: Inside the sunlit glass Living Dome, Clara kneels in damp moss coaxing a gentle golden thread of warmth into an oak root beside smiling Maya, turquoise frog Pebble, Asian teacher Marissa, and moss-feathered owl-fox Pip.

scenes.caption: Clara held the starlight dome firm while Jorge fired his woven copper snare-net from above.
scenes.alt: In the dusk-lit courtyard, Clara raises a glowing violet-gold starlight shield over Maya and Sam while two green-eyed stone sparrow gargoyles swoop into a woven copper net fired by Jorge from the balcony above.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Gray Coat in the Mist

scenes.caption: Two smoky Ink-Hounds with emerald eyes crouched beside Silas and the golden Crown Seal.
scenes.alt: Inside the stone Bell-Vault beneath a crystal prism chandelier, masked Silas and two smoky emerald-eyed Ink-Hounds confront Clara, Maya, and Sam beside a triple-locked pedestal holding the glowing golden Crown Seal.

scenes.caption: You do not burn wind, Maya grinned, calling one clean mountain gale down the tower.
scenes.alt: High in the storm-lashed belfry beneath the Brass, Leaf, and Star bells, Maya leans toward the rain with glowing Pebble while Clara and Sam channel starlight into a brass Clock-Beetle atop the frozen wooden hatch.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: The Song of the Three Bells

scenes.caption: Clara wove violet-gold starlight through copper spark and living vines as the three bells sang as one.
scenes.alt: In the Bell-Vault climax, Clara threads glowing violet-gold magic through Jorge's amber flash-drum beam and Marissa's sunlit living vines while Pip swoops overhead, Maya and Sam pull the bell ropes, and the Ink-Hounds dissolve as Silas fades into smoke.

scenes.caption: In honor of tonight's feast, Monica said, I ordered the second most expensive cider in Mistmarket.
scenes.alt: At the autumn feast in the Great Hall, Headmistress Monica raises a silver-rimmed cider pitcher as Jorge hands Clara a brass pocket-compass, Marissa and Peter smile beside them, Maya laughs with Pebble on her mug, and Sam floats a sugar cookie.

scenes.caption: Rest easy tonight, Peter promised warmly. Glassvale is well guarded.
scenes.alt: On a starlit stone balcony overlooking Glassvale Academy and the glowing Mistgate waterfall, tall warm-smiling teacher Peter rests a steady hand on Clara's shoulder with his antique brass sand-timer clipped at his belt.
